notes.title: Dusty General Update 3
notes.content:
Airbase Map Changes
Added houses to previously empty areas of the map.

Added decorative elements to houses and surrounding environments.
Bots Changes
Sheriff Bot's health reduced to 100.

All bots now share the same intelligence level.

4 new bot skins added.

Terrorist and Anti-Terrorist bots now use distinct skins for each side.

notes.title: Dusty General Update 2
notes.content:
Dusty General Update
-He sheriff bot's health has been decreased from 200 to 100.

-Kill notifier added.

-Demolition gamemode has added back.

notes.title: Dusty General Update
notes.content:
Dusty Bots Update
-Bots now have 2 difficulty levels

-Sheriff: 200 health, high accuracy — a tough and deadly opponent.

-Worker: 100 health, moderate accuracy — easier to deal with than the Sheriff.
Character Reworks
-Now the Monster has a metal head.

-Sherrif bot has a metal plate in his head.

-Blood effect has been deleted.
